destinations.name: Andermatt-Sedrun-Disentis
destinations.access: Unlimited access, every day of the season, including peak dates
destinations.note: Four index rows: Skiarena Andermatt-Sedrun, Gemsstock - Andermatt, Disentis/Muster, and Valtgeva (Druni KidsArena) at Sedrun. The epicpass.com resort page names Andermatt, Sedrun and Disentis ('Epic Pass Holders also get unlimited access to Disentis'); three of the four rows carry the resort's own website, the Disentis row has none. The Realp village lift (836fb883671e82d5d95e736971c53a4fef2e562b, 96 m vertical) is not named by the pass and is left out. Epic Local wording: '5 days each at Andermatt-Sedrun-Disentis and Crans-Montana'.

destinations.name: Hakuba Valley
destinations.access: 5 consecutive days
destinations.note: Pass wording: 'Five consecutive days of skiing and snowboarding at Hakuba Valley's ten ski resorts'. The ten are named on epicpass.com/regions/japan.aspx: Jigatake, Kashimayari, Hakuba Sanosaka, ABLE Hakuba Goryu, Hakuba 47, Hakuba Happo-one, Hakuba Iwatake, Tsugaike, Hakuba Norikura Onsen, Hakuba Cortina; ids are in that order. Hakuba Norikura Onsen is the Hakuba row, not 'Blue Resort Norikura' near Matsumoto.

destinations.name: Les 3 Vallées
destinations.access: 7 consecutive days
destinations.note: OpenSkiMap has an umbrella row (Les Trois Vallées) plus overlapping component rows (Courchevel, Méribel, Les Ménuires, Val Thorens, Orelle, Val Thorens - Orelle); all are listed so every row a tracker shows is flagged. The pass page names Courchevel, Méribel, Brides-les-Bains, Les Menuires, Saint-Martin-de-Belleville, Val Thorens and Orelle.

destinations.name: Ski Arlberg
destinations.access: 3 consecutive days with a minimum-night stay at a participating Arlberg lodging property
destinations.note: Conditional access: the three lift tickets are handed over by a participating hotel booked directly (minimum 3 nights, varies by property), once per winter season; without that stay the pass gives nothing here. Ids: the Ski Arlberg umbrella row plus its St. Anton/St. Christoph/Stuben and Lech/Zürs component rows; the pass page says 'Eligible resorts include St Anton, St Christoph, Lech, Zurs, and Stuben'. Left out: Warth-Schröcken (29248afecbb89253d31145bb08025956c1bfb71a), which skiarlberg.at counts as part of Ski Arlberg and whose ski passes it says are valid throughout the area, but which the pass does not name; Sonnenkopf (listed by skiarlberg.at under other ski resorts); and a second row named 'Ski Arlberg' (1dc7dcce3657b7b83a9395ed3bdfaf16986c8432) that has no lifts and is mostly nordic trails near Pettneu.

destinations.name: Saalbach & Zell am See-Kaprun
destinations.access: 5 days of unrestricted access across the ALPIN CARD resorts
destinations.note: Three resorts named: Skicircus Saalbach Hinterglemm Leogang Fieberbrunn, Schmittenhöhe (Zell am See), Kitzsteinhorn (Kaprun; the index row also includes Maiskogel). Access window October 10, 2026 - May 2, 2027. The Lechnerberg beginner lifts in Kaprun (4873cce0505b1f0ae19b312116de4795cabec0e7, same operator) are not named by the pass or the ALPIN CARD pages fetched and are left out.

destinations.name: Zillertal
destinations.access: 5 total consecutive days of unrestricted access across Zillertal
destinations.note: One 5-consecutive-day allotment for the whole valley, not 5 days per area. The pass page names Spieljoch, Hochfügen-Hochzillertal, Zillertal Arena, Mayrhofen and Hintertux; access window October 1, 2026 - May 15, 2027. Gerlosstein/Hainzenberg (5372192b...) is included by inference: zillertalarena.com says the Epic Pass is 'valid in all Zillertal ski resorts' and zillertal.at lists the Gerlossteinbahn among the Zillertal Arena lifts, but no page names it for the Epic Pass. New for 2026/27: last season's partner was Mayrhofen & Hintertux only, and an FAQ on the Epic Pass page still uses that older name.

destinations.name: Silvretta Montafon
destinations.access: 5 days of access
destinations.note: Silvretta Montafon only; the neighbouring Montafon areas (Golm, Gargellen, Kristberg) are not named by the pass.

destinations.name: Sölden
destinations.access: 5 days of access
destinations.note: Sölden only (not Obergurgl-Hochgurgl). Access window October 1, 2026 - May 2, 2027.
